lines: My misunderstanding is somewhere far beyond the sky
Is life nothing but goodbyes?
I could see just a little of the future, and yet
It's a goodbye
The small room I used to live in
Someone else lives there now
The cruel words you said to me
The days that felt so pointless
If only I'd done things differently then, if I could go back to that day
I can never go back to who I was back then
Say a loose, easy happiness had stretched on and on
Surely some bad seed would sprout
It's already a goodbye
A cold canned coffee on a freezing winter day
A long rainbow-colored scarf
Hurrying through the back alley, I try to remember
Say a loose, easy happiness had stretched on and on
Surely some bad seed would sprout
It's already a goodbye
Goodbye — maybe that's fine too
Take care of yourself out there somewhere
I'll manage somehow too — that's what I'll do
